answer: Run every attestation through a prism before it counts: the network splits each vote into its component signals and checks whether a ripple of agreement traces back to one operator rather than many independent agents. Identities whose influence arrives in lockstep, or whose disagreement pattern is identical, are folded back to a single weight at the nadir of the curve. A farm's thousand voices therefore refract into one, and the operator pays a thousand admission costs to buy the voice of one.
